title: Kyrie Irving offers to pay Azeez Al-Shaair's fine

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyrie Irving offers to pay Azeez Al-Shaair's fine
sources.description: The NFL has fined Texans linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair $11,941 for having a personal message written on his black eye strips during the Week 1 game against the Bills.
